Tokenizer regex runs only over trusted first-party CMS/locale copy (authored content, never end-user input). Pathological backtracking input cannot reach it; rewriting the tokenizer risks render regressions for zero reachable risk.

deepmerge@4.3.1 — no patched release exists (latest is 4.3.1). Dev-only tooling (jest-config, workbox-build via @rollup/plugin-node-resolve) merging static config objects at build/test time; never ships to production and never processes untrusted input. Mirrors security-exceptions.json.

renderDiagram output is SVG produced by our own Rust/WASM diagram crate — every label/text node passes through esc() (XML-escapes &<>"'), there is no foreignObject/htmlLabel path, and the mermaid source is first-party authored docs markdown.
Same defended sink as :178 — own WASM renderer with escaped text output over first-party diagram source.

payload.html is build-time generated markup from repo files (rendered markdown, JSON trees, pre-sanitized HTML reports) served same-origin — first-party content; the report pipeline's own sanitizer strips helper scripts, and the JSX sanitizer is bypassed intentionally to preserve <pre>/<table>/<style>.

gtag('event') only executes when window.gtag exists — the real gtag.js + Clarity tags are injected by initAnalytics() exclusively after cookie consent (scheduleAnalytics trigger). Pre-consent the dataLayer shim queues locally and is never flushed; declining consent means the tags never load.

minimatch@10.2.5 is pinned for typedoc@0.28.20 (latest upstream) which declares minimatch@^10.2.5 — v11 is API-incompatible and no 10.x patch exists (fixed: 11.0.1). Dev-only docs-generation dependency; the DoS vector needs attacker-controlled glob patterns and typedoc only globs this repo's own source at docs-build time. Never ships to production.
